english.title: Fail to arrange production of endorsed temporary use notice - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having given a temporary use notice in respect of **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed without reasonable excuse to arrange for the notice endorsed by **(..SPECIFY LICENSING AUTHORITY..) in accordance with section 227 of the Gambling Act 2005 to be produced on request to

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[an officer of HM Revenue and Customs]_
(C)_[an enforcement officer]_
(D)_[an authorised local authority officer]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 229(1)(b), (2) and (3) of the Gambling Act 2005.
